stack.backend: Java 21, Spring Boot 4 (4.1.2 or a newer 4.x patch; upstream uses 4.1.0), Maven (one project, modules allowed)
stack.identity_provider: Keycloak with the realm, clients and users of decision E1, imported at startup; password grant enabled for a public test client 'vocabulary-tests'
stack.ui: Vue 3 + Vite + TypeScript, plain component library, served by nginx that also proxies the API

tests.harness: Python 3, behave, requests; Playwright for Python for the UI steps of step 60
tests.users: from decision E1 (ga-admin, ga-viewer, ga-norole, password 'Password1!')
tests.reset: tests may not reset the store; every scenario creates its own data with a unique run id

finish_line: mvn verify green, with a JaCoCo report
